# Duns Scotus

*1266 – 1308 · Scottish · [Scholasticism](../movements/scholasticism.md)*

Scottish Franciscan theologian, nicknamed the "Subtle Doctor": he defends the univocity of being and accounts for individuality through "haecceity", against the synthesis of Thomas Aquinas.
